audience: leagues, clubs and sports organizations that run programs on LeagueApps

useCases.title: See what programs are open now
useCases.text: List the current and upcoming programs of the site. Open one to read the dates, description, pricing and registration state.

useCases.title: Get the full game schedule of a league
useCases.text: Read the schedule of a program: games with teams, times, locations and scores. Ask the assistant to write a short weekly summary.

useCases.title: List the teams and divisions of a program
useCases.text: Read the teams of a program with their division and status. Use the result for a roster overview or a message to coaches.

useCases.title: Find the fields and venues you use
useCases.text: List the locations of the site with address and sub-locations. Open one to read its coordinates.

useCases.title: Draft a newsletter from recent site news
useCases.text: Read the latest announcements and blog posts. Ask the assistant to turn them into one short newsletter text.
